validation_result.compliance_summary: This receipt for a personal meal expense (coffee and pastry) from TORREFAZIONE BAR MALABAR in Italy fails to meet several compliance requirements for the Global People ICP. The receipt is missing all mandatory Local Employer information including name (Global People s.r.l.), address, VAT number, and tax code. Additionally, as a personal meal expense, it will be subject to taxation and gross-up according to Italian regulations. A proper tax invoice with all required information should be requested from the supplier.
